They also incorporate traditional Chinese medicine, which is rare for a veterinary clinic.
They are open on Sundays by appointment. Same-day appointments are also possible.

We have been receiving homotoxicology prescriptions for our cat with kidney disease here.

We had two cats receiving care here, but one recently passed away, so I wanted to write this review to express my gratitude to the head veterinarian.

Because this hospital is far away, it's difficult to bring our cats here often. However, I was able to have several consultations with the head veterinarian alone for a second opinion, and thanks to the advice I received, my cat's condition dramatically improved. It's truly regrettable that we can't make this our regular veterinarian.

Normally, we go to a nearby hospital that only offers Western medicine. One of our cats underwent SUB system surgery there, but its numbers weren't improving. Then, this hospital prescribed homotoxicology, and it improved immediately. For the past six years, it has maintained stable numbers with homotoxicology and is perfectly healthy.

The other cat that recently passed away developed ureteral stones last year and underwent surgery at another nearby hospital. However, its condition worsened rapidly after the surgery.

We were told, "The inserted instrument may have come loose, so there's nothing more we can do," which left us feeling distrustful, wondering if it was medical malpractice, and devastated by the regret of having put our cat through such pain during surgery.

While at that hospital, my dog ​​started having seizures, so I stopped going there and, as a last resort, brought the test results to this clinic and went for a consultation with the director.

I followed the advice, including subcutaneous fluid therapy to the best of my ability, and also gave him homotoxicology. He was on the verge of death, but he recovered, and for six months from the day of our consultation until his death, he never had a single seizure, ate, and even walked on his own on his last day, passing away peacefully. His breathing was never irregular, and there was no fluid buildup in his internal organs.

I haven't returned to the hospital where he had the surgery since then; I've only had him examined at another nearby hospital. I don't know if the tube had shifted, but he was still urinating until the very end.

In short, if I hadn't taken the plunge and consulted with the director that day, he would have died in agony, having seizures, and I would have ended up harboring anger towards the hospital that performed the surgery. I am incredibly grateful to the director. I was convinced and prepared by the advice that trusted in my pet's own life force, and even if following the advice resulted in, for example, heart problems, I would still be absolutely certain that I had done the right thing.

At the previous clinic where my pet had surgery, even though it wasn't heart disease, they almost completely refused fluid therapy because they thought its heart was in danger. This worsened uremia and dehydration, causing seizures (I think this was to avoid being held responsible if something happened to the heart).

Here, the director gave me advice without any self-preservation, focusing on how to make my pet as comfortable as possible and what risks I was prepared to accept, allowing me to spend its final moments with as few regrets as possible. Thank you so much.

My other pet will also be receiving homotoxicology treatment, so I look forward to your continued support. I always appreciate the kind and reassuring service from the staff.

Thank you for reading this long message.

Three of my beloved family cats were killed due to misdiagnosis. They revealed the names and symptoms of my pets and did not uphold confidentiality. The consultation fee was three times that of other clinics.
I trust them completely because they are always kind and provide accurate treatment.
My elderly cat and I are always helped by the calm yet animal-loving doctor and staff.
Thank you for your positive feedback. We will continue to improve our service to ensure your satisfaction.

My 8-year-old rabbit suddenly developed torticollis (head tilt), and after visiting numerous emergency hospitals during Golden Week, I desperately sought out Dr. Aoyagi. I honestly thought, "He might not make it," but thanks to his appropriate treatment, he started using the litter box again, gradually began eating again, and his neck has almost completely recovered. Frankly, it's amazing. While his strong will to live and my persistent efforts to talk to him and massage him played a part, I am truly grateful that Dr. Aoyagi's approach of stimulating the body's natural healing power without worrying about side effects saved my rabbit. Because animals cannot speak, seeing their condition firsthand makes me realize that trusting Dr. Aoyagi was the right decision. I'm still cautious about his condition, but I'm confident he will recover. I am deeply grateful to Dr. Aoyagi.


It's been two and a half months since my first visit to Dr. Aoyagi. Thanks to him, his weight has returned to normal and he is almost completely recovered. Thank you so much. During a visit about a month ago, when the doctor looked at our child and asked, "Shall we consider this our goal?", our child nodded firmly before my husband and I could, and the doctor smiled, which left a strong impression on me. At the last check-up, he looked us in the eyes and said, "You don't need to come anymore." We will miss seeing the doctor, but our most important thing is that our child is healthy, so we will take our leave with gratitude.

We understand that many people, like us, visit the doctor frequently, often in a panic over their precious child, and we know that the doctor treats every child's life with love and care, which must be very stressful for him. Everyone in the community relies on Dr. Aoyagi. We pray that he takes care of himself.

I use their services for both veterinary care and grooming.

The groomers and veterinary staff work together seamlessly, so I feel completely at ease leaving my pet in their care.

They also take care of things like checking blood test results while my pet is being shampooed, administering vaccinations, and preparing any necessary medications and food.

◎The doctor's explanations are easy to understand.
◎Everyone working there is very loving and treats pets gently.
◎The grooming is stylish and adorable.
The doctors are always very considerate and helpful. They also offer traditional Chinese medicine treatments, which gives me a wider range of options.

This is a 13-year-old Miniature Schnauzer. She was unable to move due to spinal deformity, but acupuncture treatment has made a remarkable difference in her mobility. 🐕 I'm so glad my dog-walking friend recommended Pet Medical Kugahara. …
